mapper.update: UPDATE edu_course course SET course.apply_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM edu_course_apply a where a.course_id = course.id)
UPDATE edu_course course SET course.buy_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM trade_order o where o.course_id = course.id and o.status = 1)
mapper.select: select teacher.id as teacherId, teacher.name as teacherName, teacher.avatar as teacherAvatar, teacher.career as teacherCareer, subject.id as subjectId, subject.title as subjectTitle, subject.sort as subjectSort, course.id as courseId, course.title as courseTitle, course.lesson_num as courseLessonNum, course.status as courseStatus, course.view_count as courseViewCount, course.buy_count as courseBuyCount, course.apply_count as courseApplyCount, course.cover as courseCover, course.price as coursePrice, course.create_time as courseCreateTime, course.update_time as courseUpdateTime, intro.description as introDescription from edu_course course left join edu_subject subject on course.subject_id = subject.id left join edu_course_intro intro on course.id = intro.id left join edu_teacher teacher on course.teacher_id = teacher.id where course.id = #{id}

select c1.id as cid, c1.teacher_id as teacherId, c1.subject_id as subjectId, c1.title as title, c1.price as price, c1.cover as cover, c1.lesson_num as lessonNum, c1.buy_count as buyCount, c1.view_count as viewCount, c1.version as version, c1.status as status, c1.is_deleted as isDeleted, c1.create_time as createTime, c1.update_time as updateTime, t.create_time as tCreateTime, t.update_time as tCpdateTime, t.name as tName, t.career as tCareer from edu_course c1 left join edu_teacher t on c1.teacher_id = t.id where c1.is_deleted = 0
and ${ew.sqlSegment}

select c2.id as ccid, c2.course_id as courseId, c2.title as ccTitle, c2.sort as ccSort, c2.create_time as ccCreateTime, c2.update_time as ccUpdateTime, c2.is_deleted as ccIsDeleted from edu_chapter c2 where c2.course_id = #{cid} and c2.is_deleted = 0 order by c2.sort

select c3.id as cccId, c3.chapter_id as chapterId, c3.sort as sort, c3.title as cccTitle, c3.is_deleted as cccIsDeleted, c3.is_free as cccIsFree, c3.video_source_path as cccVideoSourcePath from edu_video c3 where c3.is_deleted = 0 and c3.chapter_id = #{ccid} order by c3.sort
